name: Outlast
source:
Outlast
offers an experience that goes beyond simple survival. Set in a ruthless post-apocalyptic world, the game blends adventure, exploration, and tough decisions. Follow the characters as they face deadly enemies, uncover hidden mysteries, and fight to build a safe haven.

Carefully manage resources, build and upgrade your shelter, and keep your group alive—both physically and mentally. Explore dangerous areas, confront moral dilemmas, and form bonds with characters who bear the scars of this broken world.

Every choice matters, and every mistake can be fatal. Are you ready to shape your destiny in an unforgiving world?

[From [url=https://sintycreator.itch.io/outlast]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生存
提供超越简单生存的体验。该游戏以残酷的后世界末日为背景，融合了冒险、探索和艰难的决定。跟随角色面对致命的敌人，揭开隐藏的谜团，并为建立安全港而战。

仔细管理资源，建造和升级你的庇护所，并让你的团队在身体和精神上保持活力。探索危险区域，面对道德困境，并与在这个破碎的世界中承受伤痕的角色建立联系。

每一个选择都很重要，每一个错误都可能是致命的。你准备好在这个无情的世界中塑造自己的命运了吗？

[来自[url=https://sintycreator.itch.io/outlast]Itch.io[/url]]
